trace.query: What can I do on the LSPU Portal?

retrieved_chunks.text:
SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_822
SECTION: LSPU STUDENT PORTAL: ADDRESS, ACTIVATION AND REQUESTING THE SCHOOL GOOGLE ACCOUNT
LSPU STUDENT PORTAL: ADDRESS, ACTIVATION AND REQUESTING THE SCHOOL GOOGLE ACCOUNT
Source: portal functions are from the Student Handbook Chapter 3, Article 5, Sec. 8.1.2 and the Citizen's Charter 2026 (Enrollment p. 2-3, Completion of INC/Removal p. 86-87, Enrollment Advising p. 90). The web address and the activation steps come from the maintainer (September 2026), not the Handbook or Charter. Confirm the ICT office hours and any requirements before relying on them.
The LSPU Student Portal is at myaccount.lspu.edu.ph. It is also called the Student Web Portal or the student portal.
Account requirement: an official LSPU student account. It is activated after the student is officially enrolled: visit the ICT office inside the College of Computer Studies (CCS) building and have your email and password verified.
Request your school Google account: once your portal account is active, you request your school Google account inside the LSPU Student Portal; the account is created from there.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_385
SECTION: 2021 EDITION Approved pursuant to Board Resolution No. 111, series of 2021 LSPU Student Handbook 2021 Edition
may you bring with you a homeschool atmosphere and self-fulfillment within the campus's shelter.

This handbook tells you where to go and what is offered in the University. Do not hesitate to keep in touch and consult with the Director/ Chairperson for Student Affairs and Services, the Deans/Associate Deans, and the other university officials responsible for your welfare and whose roles are laid out here. Use this handbook as a guide in finding the right person to help you with any university-related concerns. We remain our relationship with students transparent.

Provided with this guide, we wish our students to live by the LSPU core values. The University prides itself on being friendly, just as it is intellectually ambitious and innovative at the same time. LSPU works as a community because of the personal decency and mutual respect amongst administrators, faculty, personnel, and students. We respect all who come here. Likewise, we expect you to help promote the LSPU culture of honesty, courtesy, and politeness.

As it is designed, I hope this handbook serves as a useful, clear, and comprehensive guide for you to enjoy your stay here at the university.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_819
SECTION: GOOGLE WORKSPACE AT LSPU-LB (SCHOOL GOOGLE ACCOUNT)
GOOGLE WORKSPACE AT LSPU-LB (SCHOOL GOOGLE ACCOUNT)
Source: information from the project team and the maintainer that LSPU-LB mainly uses Google Workspace for study. The Student Handbook and Citizen's Charter do not describe it, except the Google Form used in Student ID processing (Citizen's Charter 2026, Business Affairs, Service 1, p. 13) and the Handbook's plan to use Google Classroom as the learning platform. Confirm the exact tools enabled and the account format with the university ICT office.
Google Workspace is Google's suite of online tools (Gmail, Classroom, Meet, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Calendar). It is mainly used at LSPU-LB for school-related activities: official school email, online classes and meetings, sharing and submitting coursework, group projects, forms and surveys, and schedules. Students use their school Google account to access these tools.
Account requirement: a school-issued Google account. Students request it inside the LSPU Student Portal once their portal account is active. The exact account format is not documented.
Because it is requested through the portal, activate your portal account first at the ICT office inside the CCS building.

8.1.3. Registrar Visitation. In case any of the options mentioned above are not available, the student may visit the Office of the Registrar to directly consult and/or review his/her enrollment status to check deficiencies and related concerns.

trace.answer_for_eval:
On the LSPU Portal, you can do the following:

1. Enlist subjects for enrollment
2. Check your enrollment status
3. Apply online for the completion of INC or a 4.0 grade
4. Request the school Google account
5. Verify grades against the Registrar's report
6. View your Certificate of Registration (COR)
7. View grades

The LSPU Student Portal is at myaccount.lspu.edu.ph. It is also called the Student Web Portal or the student portal.
Account requirement: an official LSPU student account. It is activated after the student is officially enrolled: visit the ICT office inside the College of Computer Studies (CCS) building and have your email and password verified.
Request your school Google account: once your portal account is active, you request your school Google account inside the LSPU Student Portal; the account is created from there.

GOOGLE WORKSPACE AT LSPU-LB (SCHOOL GOOGLE ACCOUNT)
Source: information from the project team and the maintainer that LSPU-LB mainly uses Google Workspace for study. The Student Handbook and Citizen's Charter do not describe it, except the Google Form used in Student ID processing (Citizen's Charter 2026, Business Affairs, Service 1, p. 13) and the Handbook's plan to use Google Classroom as the learning platform. Confirm the exact tools enabled and the account format with the university ICT office.
Google Workspace is Google's suite of online tools (Gmail, Classroom, Meet, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Calendar). It is mainly used at LSPU-LB for school-related activities: official school email, online classes and meetings, sharing and submitting coursework, group projects, forms and surveys, and schedules. Students use their school Google account to access these tools.
Account requirement: a school-issued Google account. Students request it inside the LSPU Student Portal once their portal account is active. The exact account format is not documented.
Because it is requested through the portal, activate your portal account first at the ICT office inside the CCS building.
